title: Bill Status
prompt:
Create an in-memory system for monitoring bills. It must register a bill with an identifier, amount, and due date; change whether a registered bill has been paid; and retrieve every bill that is still unpaid, ordered from earliest due date to latest.

The implementation must remain correct when multiple threads invoke operations concurrently. Submit complete code for the tracker and tests demonstrating correctness.

Use the following interface:

PaymentStatus has UNPAID = "unpaid" and PAID = "paid".
BillStatusTracker.add_bill(self, bill_id: str, amount_cents: int, due_date: date) -> None
BillStatusTracker.update_payment_status(self, bill_id: str, status: PaymentStatus) -> None
BillStatusTracker.get_unpaid_bills(self) -> list[dict]

Each returned dictionary contains bill_id, amount_cents, due_date, and status. Newly added bills begin with PaymentStatus.UNPAID. For bills with the same due date, use any consistent ordering.

Constraints: keep all bill data in memory; bill_id values are unique; amount_cents is a non-negative integer; due_date is a calendar date; status updates refer to existing bills. Tests should cover ordinary usage, paid/unpaid filtering, due-date ordering, repeated status changes, empty results, and concurrent access.

example.reasoning: The bill due August 12 is omitted after it is marked paid, and the remaining bills are ordered by due date.
